Navigation does not universally require retry to continue. If the target contract revokes the command, follow that policy rather than importing historical retention.

rules.body: Apply when trailing editor persistence must preserve synchronous departure persistence and navigation from inline saved integrations. TASK states: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing utility: after a 120 ms quiet interval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts must continue to save." README.md states: "When close/open returns, the departed document's last accepted edit is available\nthrough the store, even if the next view selects a different document." docs/host-api.md states: "onSaved is called inline and can navigate or edit; rendering is an output sink."

Enqueue each accepted edit in the existing reusable 120 ms trailing task, replacing pending text and restarting its deadline. Keep persistence bound to the accepting document rather than the later selection. src/workflow.php binds the callback with "$this->task=new Trailing($env,120,function($text) use ($env,$id) { $env->write($id,$text); });" Preserve empty text and the no-selection no-op established by "function edit($text) { $selected=$this->current; if ($selected) $selected->accept($text); }". Subsequent bursts must remain usable.

Consume pending state before invoking callback-capable persistence. Preserve src/workflow.php ordering: "$value=$this->pending; $this->pending=null; $this->handle=null;\n        if ($value !== null) ($this->work)($value);" Nested flushing must not duplicate the consumed batch, and completion cleanup must not erase work accepted by a save callback.

On departure, capture the old visit, revoke its current ownership, detach its subscription, and complete its clearing output before flushing pending persistence. Flush before reading the replacement document and before departure returns. src/workflow.php already revokes ownership with "private function retire() { $old=$this->current; $this->current=null; if ($old) $old->depart(); else $this->env->output('document',null); }" and clears the captured visit with "function depart() { ($this->stop)();$this->env->output('document',null); }". Add persistence after those outgoing effects so callbacks cannot have their successor output cleared by the older departure. Preserve this behavior for switching, same-document reopening, close, and dispose.

After callback-capable departure persistence, recheck the initiating navigation request before installing its destination. Preserve the existing generation check in src/workflow.php: "if ($ticket!==$this->generation) return;" README.md states: "Later navigation means the navigation request that starts later takes precedence, even if an earlier request returns afterward." An inline open or close must remain authoritative after the outer navigation returns, including edits accepted by the callback-created visit.

Preserve synchronous interfaces, committed record and revision semantics, subscription cleanup and document filtering, fresh visits, and renderer payloads. docs/host-api.md states: "Store delivery writes first, snapshots subscriptions, and skips removed listeners." It also states: "Every open creates a fresh visit and subscription, including same-key reopen." src/workflow.php filters status with "if ($e['id']===$id) $env->output('status',$e);" and delegates disposal with "function dispose() { $this->close(); }". Persistent records do not themselves require persistent per-document task banks or additional presentation layers.

Keep transient preview policy separate from document departure persistence. TASK states: "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." README.md states: "It publishes after a\n40 ms quiet interval; hiding it discards an unpublished query. It can be reused." Preserve preview cancellation rather than generalizing departure flushing to it. Do not import submission or projection-history obligations from related experiences, or invent callbacks from rendering output sinks.

With pending edits, check switch, same-document reopen, close, and dispose for original-document persistence before return, fresh restored text, and departing subscription removal before save delivery. Trigger nested open and close from timer-driven and departure-driven saves; verify later navigation and successor output survive, callback-created edits save independently, and consumed batches are not repeated. Check active status filtering and unchanged preview delay, hide cancellation, and reuse. These checks operationalize TASK and public source behavior; acceptance observations add no requirements.

rules.body: Apply when adding buffer discard while retaining the owning subject and its subscribers. Distinguish the buffered result's lifetime from the subject's and subscribers' lifetimes.

Discard both stored content and its presence while active, without notifying subscribers or changing terminal state. TASK: "While the subject is active, clear must remove its buffered value without emitting a notification or completing the subject. Calling it when no value is buffered, or calling it repeatedly, is harmless." Keep presence distinct from content: TASK also states, "A later next call can establish a new buffered value, including undefined." Do not implement clearing as next(undefined), completion, or unsubscription.

Protect the earliest terminal boundary, including synchronous delivery before completion returns. TASK: "Clear must have no effect on a completed, errored, or unsubscribed subject." Original rxjs/src/internal/AsyncSubject.ts contains "this._isComplete = true;\n      _hasValue && super.next(_value!);\n      super.complete();" and subscription finalization checks "} else if (isStopped || _isComplete) {". Therefore clear must respect _isComplete during inline value callbacks, rather than relying solely on a stopped flag set by the later superclass completion. Preserve the committed buffer for reentrant and subsequent subscriptions.

Keep the change local to buffer discard and preserve existing operation semantics and instance ownership. TASK: "Preserve the current behavior of next, error, complete, and subscribe, and keep each instance independent." README.md: "The consumer can call API operations from inline subscriber callbacks; instances keep separate buffers." Original rxjs/src/internal/AsyncSubject.ts snapshots "const { _hasValue, _value, _isComplete } = this;" at completion entry. Retain that delivery behavior; adding clear does not authorize changing existing next or completion reentry semantics.

Do not transfer unrelated queue, preview, readiness, cancellation or asynchronous cleanup policies into this API. TASK: "Preserve the full declared upstream API and regression behavior." Preserve the framework dispatch and subscription results; src/Workspace.vue already contains "case 'clear':if(typeof s.subject.clear==='function')s.subject.clear();else throw Error('clear API unavailable');break;". The presence of multiple subscribers does not establish independent-consumer policies from other cases.

Logical retirement must reject further packets even while synchronous startup has not returned its handle. README.md: "One startup window is relevant to this maintenance request: start may emit
more than one packet synchronously. A showProgress callback may select or hide
another visit before start returns, while its caller has not yet received the
returned cleanup handle."

Separate reception order, audit completion and visible publication. Bind admitted decoding to its original file, attempt and visit; retain its audit once on completion even after cancellation, navigation or disposal. README.md: "Removing a listener commits removal before calling the host detach callback;\nthat callback may synchronously select, hide or dispose. Repeated removal is\ninert. Host callbacks execute synchronously unless explicitly deferred." Preserve idempotent cancellation and disposal. Keep accepted retry work bound to its entry visit and file: cancel the preceding attempt before enqueueing, retain the accepted command and record across cancellation reentry, cancel its resulting handle if its visit ended, and suppress its retired queued notice. Original src/workflow.php: "$v->handle->cancel(); $accepted=$v;$h=$this->enqueue($accepted,'retry');if($this->current($accepted))$accepted->handle=$h;else $h->cancel();if($this->current($accepted))$this->notice($accepted,$h);"

Preserve queue recording before transfer startup, adapter interfaces, payload identities, per-workspace counters and ordinary streaming. TASK: "Restore the initial progress update without changing the public\ntransfer, retry, navigation, cleanup, audit, or queue-record behavior." Do not add queue fields under this repair. Keep panel freshness changes separate from diagnostic behavior. Keep its existing behavior during this maintenance." Do not transfer the panel's startup or freshness policy to Telemetry.
